caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a stone pedestal or urn with a rounded, bowl-like upper section and a multi-tiered, angular base. The upper part of the object features an even pattern of vertical, oval-shaped indents or grooves that encircle its surface. The middle section where the bowl meets the base is slightly narrower and angular, leading to a square, flared pedestal with chamfered edges. The color palette primarily consists of light browns, beiges, and muted purples with subtle greenish and pinkish hues, giving the appearance of aged stone. The object appears centered on a plain, off-white or light beige background, with no other objects or background elements present. The shading and lines used in the drawing suggest a hand-drawn and watercolor effect, giving the object a three-dimensional appearance.
title: Stone Baptismal Font
